Legislature: who controls the House and Senate?

Each bar is one seat. Seats are split by who is ahead (DFL left, Republicans right), then ordered from most reported at the outer edges to least reported at the center. Darker = bigger margin; the fill rises as precincts report. The black line marks the halfway point. Estimates blend votes counted so far with each district's 2024 presidential result, adjusted for how the DFL is running tonight.

Statewide races

Swing compares tonight with past elections, using only counties that are fully counted, so early numbers aren't skewed by which areas report first. Positive = toward the DFL.

Legislative districts

"Counted" = all precincts in (unofficial, not certified). Win chance only covers the uncounted share of the vote. "vs 2024 Pres" compares the count so far with Harris–Trump in the same district. Independent candidates aren't modeled.
